name: Default max_allowed_packet boundary through pushed CONCAT and SPACE

payload.shape: four individually legal 16 MB SPACE results plus one byte cross the default 64 MB max_allowed_packet only at CONCAT
payload.red: TiKV returns non-NULL and supplies the row to DELETE; TiDB returns error 1301 under strict DML
payload.green: three SPACE results plus one byte stay below the boundary on both evaluators
payload.settings: default max_allowed_packet=67108864, strict sql_mode, MDL ON

name: Pushed string functions preserve max_allowed_packet semantics

payload.red: remote DELETE succeeds and removes rows while root DELETE returns 1301
payload.green: same expression below the boundary agrees
